解析：

$$P=x^4+4xy^3,\quad Q=6x^2y^2-5y^4,$$

$$\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}=12xy^2=\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x},$$

$$\left(x^4+4xy^3\right)dx+\left(6x^2y^2-5y^4\right)dy$$

$$=d\left(\frac{x^5}{5}\right)+2y^3d\left(x^2\right)+2x^2d\left(y^3\right)-d\left(y^5\right)$$

$$=d\left(\frac{x^5}{5}+2x^2y^3-y^5\right),$$

从而，

原式 $=d\left(\frac{x^5}{5}+2x^2y^3-y^5\right)\Big|_{(-2,-1)}^{(3,0)}=62$
